title: Chi-free core finite-level root normalization comparison
statement: After expanding the scalar and abelian adjunction transposes to their units, the scalar-unit/geometric-transpose value at one finite level and pro-etale chart is HEq to the abelian-transpose value for the integral root comparison.

source.place: Paragraph (2), finite-level evaluation of the abelian transpose before assembling the tower map

proof.text: Evaluate the scalar unit as the sheafified pure tensor, evaluate the ordinary geometric transpose on that tensor, and use the normalized line comparison. The Kummer boundary square, hk, and d.kummer_roots identify its root with restrictRoot; LinePullback.normalization then gives the same finite Tate tensor as the abelian transpose after d.rootIso.
